create_model_like: create a new HuggingFace Transformers model module by duplicating an existing model type
add_model_auto_mappings: add a new model to all auto mapping registrations in the Transformers auto module
create_modular_file: create a modular model file that subclasses all classes from an existing model module
create_test_files: create test files for a new model by copying and adapting existing model tests
create_doc_file: create a documentation markdown file for a new model with class autodoc references
